source.title: Network and Environment Capabilities
source.applicability: US Department of Defense Zero Trust Framework implementation

passages.text: Tailor the control access policies to address each driver's specifics, whether for regulatory compliance or data security requirements.

Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), where permissions are assigned based on the role of the User/PE/NPE. Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), where a combination of several factors related to User/PE/NPE, data, and the environment are leveraged to restrict or allow network access based on a set of predefined rules and conditions.
